name: yoinks
description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
one_liner: A simple command-line tool that downloads videos from the internet straight to your computer, without shady ad-filled download websites.
buyer: A content creator or social media manager who needs to save source videos quickly and cleanly for repurposing clips, reaction content, or archiving.
business_use_cases: A social media manager downloads videos from various platforms to repurpose clips for a client's account where licensing allows it.
A researcher archives video content for documentation before it potentially gets taken down.
A video editor builds a simple tool for clients to batch-download their own uploaded content for backup across platforms.

money_ideas.idea: Bundle it into a simple desktop app with a drag-and-drop GUI for non-technical creators, sold as a one-time license.

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple drag-and-drop desktop app this weekend and sell it as a $9 one-time tool to non-technical creators who don't want to use the terminal.
